name: STOP! Word Duel
desc:
🛑 One letter. Five categories. Three rounds. Play STOP in a word showdown for 2 to 4 players!

Write your answers and hit STOP before the others. Correct answers that nobody else used score double.

🪑 Lose the match and get launched out of your chair.
💰 Earn in-game cash and unlock chairs and STOP sounds.
🤖 Practice against a bot when no opponent is available.
🎁 Claim daily gifts and one-time playtime rewards.
🏆 Compete on the global leaderboards.

Think fast. Find an answer nobody else thought of. Hit STOP!

scripts.title: Word Solver | Dictionary Helper & Autopilot
scripts.features:
⚡ FEATURE OVERVIEW

• Smart Game Tracking — Automatically reads the screen to know exactly which question you are on and when the round is finished.
• Safe Auto-Typing — Types answers for you at a natural speed so it looks like a real player. It stops exactly when the 5th question is done to prevent spam or glitches.
• Massive Answer Dictionary — Knows the correct answers for over 20 game categories (animals, countries, food, brands, etc.) and has a backup dictionary for rare letters.
• 1-Click Typing — Provides a list of suggested words. Just click the button next to any word to instantly type it yourself.
• Clean Floating Menu — A sleek, draggable dark-mode interface that will not block your gameplay. Includes a live round progress bar.
